title: Manager – E-Tail Hub & CPU Operations | (Pataudi Hub) 361749
description:
Job Title
   

  

 Manager – E\-Tail Hub \& CPU Operations
   

  

 Function
   

  

 E\-Tail Operations
   

  

 Reports To
   

  

 Regional Manager – E\-Tail CPU Operations (North)
   

  

 Location
   

  

 National Hub Centre (NHC)
   

  

 Travel Required
   

  

 25% ☑ 50% ☐ 75% ☐
   

  

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**
 Blue Dart Express Limited, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage and communications business, since May 2004\.
   

  

 Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.
   

  

 We are proud to be consistently ranked among India’s Top\-100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
   

  

 If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 The Manager – E\-Tail Hub \& CPU Operations is responsible for leading one of Blue Dart's largest integrated E\-Tail processing facilities, overseeing end\-to\-end Hub and CPU operations to ensure operational excellence, service reliability, network efficiency, and customer satisfaction. Reporting to the Regional Manager – E\-Tail CPU Operations (North), the role provides operational leadership across inbound and outbound processing, sorter operations, middle\-mile connectivity, fleet planning, manpower productivity, safety, compliance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
   

  

 As the National Hub Centre (NHC) continues to expand its processing capacity and network footprint, this role will play a critical role in ensuring scalable operations, operational resilience, cost optimization, and seamless execution of Blue Dart's service commitments while driving operational excellence across Hub and CPU operations.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 To lead and manage the end\-to\-end operations of the National Hub Centre (NHC) by delivering industry\-leading service quality, ensuring efficient Hub and CPU operations, optimizing operational productivity, strengthening network connectivity, driving continuous improvement initiatives, and maintaining the highest standards of safety, compliance, and customer experience
 **.**
**Key Roles \& Responsibilities**
**Facility Leadership \& Operational Governance**
* Lead the day\-to\-day operations of the National Hub Centre (NHC) ensuring seamless execution across Hub and CPU operations.
* Drive operational governance through structured daily, weekly, and monthly performance reviews.
* Ensure adherence to operational policies, standard operating procedures, and service commitments.
* Monitor operational performance through MIS, dashboards, and KPI reviews.
* Drive operational discipline, accountability, and execution excellence across all shifts.


**Hub \& CPU Operations Management**
* Lead end\-to\-end inbound, outbound, sorting, processing, and dispatch operations.
* Ensure efficient processing of shipments while consistently meeting CPT, SLA, and network commitments.
* Drive sorter productivity and optimize sortation processes.
* Ensure timely connectivity of shipments into the Blue Dart network.
* Continuously improve throughput while maintaining operational accuracy.
* Ensure optimal utilization of processing infrastructure and operational resources.


**Middle Mile \& Fleet Operations**
* Lead feeder planning and execution to ensure timely movement of shipments across the network.
* Optimize fleet deployment, vehicle utilization, and transportation schedules.
* Ensure effective coordination with linehaul teams for seamless shipment movement.
* Monitor feeder adherence, turnaround times, and operational efficiency.
* Drive route optimization and network productivity improvements.


**Service Excellence \& Customer Experience**
* Drive achievement of Net Service Levels (NSL), On\-Time Processing, CPT adherence, and operational SLAs.
* Reduce shipment exceptions, operational errors, and RTO occurrences.
* Strengthen shipment visibility and operational responsiveness.
* Ensure timely resolution of operational escalations impacting customers.
* Support superior customer experience through reliable operational execution.


**Productivity \& Cost Optimization**
* Optimize manpower deployment across multiple shifts.
* Improve labour productivity, shipment handling efficiency, and operational throughput.
* Drive cost optimization through improved resource utilization and operational planning.
* Monitor operational productivity metrics and implement corrective actions where required.
* Support initiatives aimed at improving CPK and overall operational efficiency.


**Safety, Security \& Compliance**
* Ensure compliance with Blue Dart operational, statutory, safety, and security standards.
* Promote a strong safety culture across the facility.
* Ensure compliance with audit requirements and operational governance standards.
* Drive incident prevention and proactive risk mitigation.
* Ensure adherence to quality, regulatory, and operational compliance requirements.


**People Leadership \& Capability Development**
* Lead, coach, and develop Shift Managers, Hub Supervisors, and Fleet teams.
* Drive employee engagement, capability development, and succession planning.
* Build a high\-performance culture focused on accountability and operational excellence.
* Ensure effective manpower planning across shifts.
* Drive continuous learning and skill enhancement across operational teams.


**Continuous Improvement \& Automation**
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through process optimization and automation.
* Drive Lean and Continuous Improvement initiatives across Hub and CPU operations.
* Support implementation of digital initiatives that improve operational visibility and productivity.
* Promote innovation and best practices across the facility.
* Lead operational improvement projects to enhance throughput, quality, and customer experience.


**Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Work closely with Regional Operations, Network Planning, Transportation, Security, Engineering, HR, and Commercial teams to ensure seamless execution.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to improve operational performance.
* Support implementation of new operational initiatives and network expansion projects.
* Drive alignment between operational priorities and business objectives.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
**Education**
* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Operations, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* MBA or Postgraduate qualification in Operations, Supply Chain, or Management preferred.


**Experience**
* 8–12 years of experience in logistics, express distribution, eCommerce fulfilment, warehousing, Hub Operations, or integrated supply chain operations.
* Proven experience managing large Hub, Processing Centre, Distribution Centre, or Fulfilment Centre operations.
* Strong experience in sorter operations, Hub management, linehaul coordination, and network planning.
* Demonstrated experience managing high\-volume shipment processing and large operational teams.
* Experience in manpower planning, productivity improvement, operational governance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Exposure to automation, operational analytics, and Lean methodologies will be an advantage.


**Skills \& Capabilities**
**Technical Skills**
* Hub \& CPU Operations Management
* Sortation \& Processing Operations
* Middle Mile \& Fleet Operations
* Network Planning \& Connectivity
* Capacity Planning
* Workforce Planning \& Productivity Management
* Cost Optimization \& Operational Efficiency
* Operational Analytics \& MIS

**Behavioural Competencies**

**Key Performance Indicators**

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**
 When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.

* Great Place to Work® Certified—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.

 This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. Come grow with us.

title: General Manager
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION** 




 Position: General Manager – Footwear / Business Head – Footwear
 



**Department:** 
 Business / Operations
 



**Industry:** 
 Footwear / Fashion / Retail
 



**Location:** 
 Bahadurgarh
 



**Reports To:** 
 Director / Managing Director
 



**Experience:** 
 15\+ Years
 



**Education:** 
 Graduate / MBA Preferred
 



 1\. POSITION OVERVIEW
 



 We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven
 **General Manager – Footwear / Business Head – Footwear** 
 to take overall responsibility for the company’s footwear business.
 



 The role will be responsible for
 **business strategy, P\&L, sales, retail operations, merchandising, inventory, distribution, manufacturing coordination, team leadership, and business growth** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong experience in the
 **footwear, fashion, lifestyle, or retail industry** 
 , with the ability to manage multiple functions and drive business performance from strategy through execution.
 



 2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



 A. Overall Business Management
 


* Take overall responsibility for the company’s footwear business and day\-to\-day operations.
* Develop and execute business strategies to achieve revenue growth and profitability.
* Work closely with the Directors / Management on business planning and strategic decisions.
* Monitor overall business performance and ensure achievement of business objectives.
* Identify new business opportunities, markets, channels, and expansion opportunities.
* Establish clear business priorities, targets, and performance measures.



 B. P\&L and Financial Management
 


* Take complete ownership of the business P\&L.
* Monitor revenue, gross margins, operating costs, EBITDA, and profitability.
* Develop strategies to improve margins and overall business efficiency.
* Review MIS, sales reports, inventory performance, and financial KPIs.
* Control operating expenses and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
* Ensure business decisions are aligned with financial objectives.



 C. Sales \& Retail Operations
 


* Lead sales across
 **Exclusive Brand Outlets (EBOs), Multi\-Brand Outlets (MBOs), distributors, wholesale, e\-commerce, and other relevant channels** 
 .
* Drive sales growth, store productivity, conversion, and customer experience.
* Monitor store\-wise, region\-wise, and channel\-wise performance.
* Develop strategies for new store openings and retail expansion.
* Ensure implementation of company SOPs, operating standards, and service standards.
* Drive achievement of sales targets and improve sales team productivity.



 D. Footwear Merchandising \& Product Management
 


* Oversee footwear merchandising, product planning, assortment, pricing, and product lifecycle.
* Analyze market trends, customer preferences, competition, pricing, and product positioning.
* Coordinate with merchandising, design, sourcing, production, and sales teams.
* Ensure the right product mix and assortment across different sales channels.
* Review product performance and recommend additions, modifications, or discontinuation based on market and sales data.
* Ensure timely product launches and seasonal range planning.



 E. Inventory \& Supply Chain Management
 


* Oversee inventory planning, stock replenishment, ageing, and product availability.
* Monitor stock movement and minimize slow\-moving, excess, and obsolete inventory.
* Coordinate with procurement, production, warehouse, and distribution teams.
* Ensure timely availability and movement of products across stores and sales channels.
* Improve inventory turnover and optimize working capital.
* Establish effective stock allocation and replenishment systems.



 F. Manufacturing \& Quality Coordination
 


* Coordinate with manufacturing and production teams to ensure quality, cost efficiency, and timely delivery.
* Monitor production planning and operational requirements.
* Ensure implementation of quality systems, SOPs, and process standards.
* Coordinate with QA/QC teams to maintain product quality.
* Review and resolve customer/product quality issues.
* Work with production and sourcing teams to improve product quality, cost, and delivery timelines.



 G. Distribution \& Business Development
 


* Develop and strengthen
 **MBO, wholesale, distributor, export, e\-commerce, and other business channels** 
 .
* Identify new markets, territories, customers, and business opportunities.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, channel partners, distributors, and vendors.
* Develop go\-to\-market strategies for new products, markets, and channels.
* Drive business expansion and improve channel productivity.
* Evaluate potential partnerships and new routes to market.



 H. Team Leadership \& People Management
 


* Lead cross\-functional teams across sales, retail, merchandising, operations, supply chain, and support functions.
* Define departmental KPIs, targets, and performance standards.
* Monitor individual and team performance.
* Coach, mentor, and develop managers and team members.
* Ensure effective manpower planning and deployment.
* Build a performance\-oriented and accountable organizational culture.



 I. Operations \& Process Improvement
 


* Improve business processes, operational efficiency, and productivity.
* Develop, implement, and monitor SOPs across business functions.
* Use MIS, analytics, and performance data for informed decision\-making.
* Identify operational gaps and implement corrective actions.
* Improve coordination between business functions.
* Drive continuous improvement in cost, productivity, service levels, and operational efficiency.



 J. Brand \& Customer Experience
 


* Maintain brand standards across stores and all customer touchpoints.
* Work closely with marketing, visual merchandising, e\-commerce, and PR teams.
* Improve customer experience and brand presentation.
* Ensure consistent brand positioning across offline and online channels.
* Support brand\-building and expansion initiatives.
* Monitor customer feedback and implement improvements where required.



 3\. CANDIDATE PROFILE
 



 Educational Qualification
 


* Graduate in any discipline.
* MBA / PGDM in Business Management, Marketing, Retail, Operations, or a related field will be preferred.



 Experience
 


* Minimum
 **15\+ years of relevant experience** 
 in footwear, fashion, retail, manufacturing, lifestyle, consumer products, or related industries.
* Strong experience in business leadership, retail operations, sales, and P\&L management.
* Experience managing multiple retail formats and sales channels.
* Strong understanding of footwear merchandising, inventory, distribution, and customer experience.
* Experience in manufacturing, sourcing, quality, supply chain, or production coordination will be an advantage.



 Key Competencies
 


* Business Leadership \& Strategic Thinking
* P\&L and Commercial Management
* Sales \& Retail Management
* Footwear Merchandising
* Inventory \& Supply Chain Management
* Channel \& Distribution Management
* Business Development
* Team Leadership \& People Management
* Negotiation \& Vendor Management
* Analytical \& Data\-Driven Decision Making
* Problem Solving
* Process Improvement
* Customer \& Brand Orientation
* Strong Communication and Stakeholder Management



 4\. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)
 



 The position will be evaluated on the following key performance parameters:
 


* Overall revenue and business growth
* P\&L and profitability
* Gross margin improvement
* Retail and channel sales
* Store productivity
* Same\-store sales growth
* Inventory turnover
* Inventory ageing and liquidation
* Product availability
* New market and channel expansion
* Customer experience
* Team productivity
* Operational efficiency
* Product quality
* Business process improvement
* Working capital efficiency



 5\. PREFERRED INDUSTRY BACKGROUND
 



 Candidates from the following industries will be preferred:
 


* Footwear Manufacturing
* Footwear Retail
* Fashion Retail
* Lifestyle
* Consumer Products
* Premium / Luxury Retail
* Apparel \& Accessories
* Branded Consumer Goods



 6\. REPORTING STRUCTURE
 



**Reports To:** 
 Director / Managing Director
 



**Position:** 
 General Manager – Footwear / Business Head – Footwear
 



**Functional Scope:** 




 Business Strategy \| P\&L \| Sales \| Retail \| Merchandising \| Inventory \| Supply Chain \| Distribution \| Manufacturing Coordination \| Business Development \| Team Management \| Brand \& Customer Experience
 



 7\. ROLE OBJECTIVE
 



 The primary objective of the
 **General Manager – Footwear / Business Head – Footwear** 
 is to lead the overall footwear business with end\-to\-end accountability for
 **growth, revenue, profitability, operational excellence, customer experience, and organizational capability** 
 , while building sustainable business performance across retail, wholesale, distribution, e\-commerce, and other strategic channels.

title: HVAC Engineer (O&M)
description:
**Job Description:** 
 HVAC Engineer, Operations and Maintenance
 



**Position** 
 :
 **HVAC Engineer, Operations and Maintenance** 




**Department** 
 : Infrastructure Campus Operations \& Estate Development
 



**Experience** 
 :
 **Minimum of 12 plus years of relevant experience in HVAC operations and maintenance,** 
 preferably in large institutional, university, commercial, hospitality, residential, or integrated campus environments.
 



**Qualification** 
 :
 **Diploma or B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering** 




 Additional certification in HVAC, refrigeration, energy management, or facilities management will be an advantage.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 
 The HVAC Engineer will be responsible for the
 **operation, maintenance, performance monitoring, and reliable functioning of HVAC systems across the campus** 
 . The role will ensure comfortable indoor temperatures, uninterrupted chilled water supply, timely preventive and corrective maintenance, effective vendor management, and minimum equipment downtime.
 



 The position will work closely with internal technical teams, external vendors, contractors, and campus stakeholders to ensure that all HVAC assets operate safely, efficiently, and at their designed capacity.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. HVAC Operations and Performance
 


1. Ensure comfortable indoor temperatures of
 **23°C to 25°C** 
 across designated campus facilities, based on occupancy, weather conditions, and operational requirements.
2. Monitor and manage the operation of
 **chillers, AHUs, FCUs, ventilation systems, pumps, cooling towers, ventilation equipment, and associated HVAC systems** 
 .
3. Ensure reliable chilled water supply to support the efficient operation of air conditioning systems installed across workspaces, academic buildings, administrative facilities, residences, and other designated areas.
4. Monitor HVAC equipment performance and identify deviations, abnormal operating conditions, and potential equipment failures.
5. Ensure all fixed HVAC systems, excluding student hostels where separately assigned, operate at their designed capacity and are maintained as per recommended standards.
6. Monitor energy consumption and equipment performance to identify opportunities for improved operational efficiency.



 2\. Preventive and Corrective Maintenance
 


1. Develop, implement, and monitor
 **preventive, predictive, corrective, and periodic maintenance schedules** 
 for HVAC systems.
2. Ensure timely servicing, inspection, cleaning, calibration, and replacement of components to maintain equipment reliability.
3. Conduct preventive maintenance of
 **FCUs and AHUs in Student Hostels SH 11, SH 12, and SH 14** 
 .
4. Attend and coordinate the resolution of HVAC breakdowns and technical failures within defined SLA timelines.
5. Maintain adequate stock of
 **critical HVAC spare parts, consumables, and essential maintenance materials** 
 to minimize equipment downtime.
6. Analyse recurring breakdowns and recommend appropriate corrective measures to prevent repeated failures.
7. Ensure proper maintenance records are maintained for all major HVAC equipment and systems.



 3\. Chiller Plant Management
 


1. Maintain daily operational logs for chiller plants, including operating parameters, temperatures, pressures, running hours, alarms, and other relevant performance indicators.
2. Monitor chiller plant efficiency and identify abnormal trends requiring servicing or corrective action.
3. Coordinate scheduled servicing and major maintenance activities for chillers, pumps, cooling towers, and associated equipment.
4. Ensure timely escalation of critical equipment issues and coordinate with specialized service agencies wherever required.



 4\. Vendor and AMC Management
 


1. Coordinate with HVAC vendors and service agencies for
 **Annual Maintenance Contracts, breakdown support, equipment servicing, installation, testing, and commissioning** 
 .
2. Monitor vendor performance against agreed SLAs, maintenance schedules, and contractual requirements.
3. Verify service reports, work completion, site measurements, and equipment performance before recommending vendor payments.
4. Coordinate with vendors during installation and commissioning of new HVAC equipment and ensure compliance with approved specifications.
5. Maintain proper documentation related to AMC agreements, service reports, breakdowns, warranties, and equipment history.



 5\. Complaint and SLA Management
 


1. Monitor HVAC related complaints received from occupants, faculty, staff, and other campus users.
2. Ensure complaints are assigned, attended to, and resolved within defined
 **SLA timelines** 
 .
3. Coordinate with technicians and vendors for timely resolution of recurring or technically complex complaints.
4. Analyse complaint trends and recommend improvements to reduce recurring HVAC issues.



 6\. Hostel Technical Services
 


1. Initially oversee technical services in designated student hostels, including
 **HVAC, electrical, plumbing, civil, and carpentry\-related requirements** 
 , in coordination with the respective teams.
2. Subsequently focus primarily on
 **HVAC Operations and Maintenance for student hostels** 
 as responsibilities are transitioned to the relevant technical teams.
3. Ensure preventive and corrective maintenance of HVAC systems in designated hostels and maintain service records.
4. Ensure timely availability of materials, tools, spare parts, and manpower required for hostel HVAC maintenance.



 7\. Documentation, BOQ and Commercial Coordination
 


1. Prepare and review
 **BOQs, material indents, technical specifications, estimates, and site measurements** 
 related to HVAC works.
2. Process and verify vendor invoices based on completed work, service reports, approved BOQs, and actual site measurements.
3. Maintain accurate records of equipment inventories, maintenance history, breakdowns, spare parts, AMC activities, and service schedules.
4. Support budgeting and procurement activities for HVAC maintenance, replacement, and improvement projects.



 8\. Team Management and Training
 


1. Supervise and coordinate HVAC technicians, operators, and ground\-level technical staff.
2. Train ground staff on the
 **safe and proper operation, basic troubleshooting, and routine maintenance of HVAC equipment** 
 .
3. Verify staff attendance, work allocation, productivity, and performance.
4. Ensure technicians follow approved safety procedures, maintenance practices, and operational protocols.
5. Conduct regular toolbox talks and technical briefings wherever required.



  





**Preferred Experience: E** 
 xperience in
 **large universities, institutional campuses, hospitals, hotels, commercial complexes, residential facilities, or other large\-scale facilities** 
 with centralized HVAC and chilled water systems will be preferred.

title: Community Manager
description:
**Job Description** 




  





**About Newton School of Technology:** 




 Newton School of Technology (NST) is a new\-age institution redefining technical education in India. Founded by IIT alumni, NST offers a 4\-year B.Tech in Computer Science and AI, focused on hands\-on learning and deep industry integration. Within two years, over 93% of students have secured paid internships with companies like Razorpay, SarvamAI, and DRDO, along with global exposure through tech treks to Singapore and Silicon Valley. Led by a distinguished faculty comprising ICPC World Finalists and ex\-professionals from ISRO, Microsoft, MakeMyTrip, and several other leading tech organizations, NST is building a scalable, high\-impact model that produces industry\-ready talent for the world's most advanced technology roles.
 



  





**About the role** 




 The Community Manager owns the full community charter for their campus. This is a leadership role responsible for designing, executing, and continuously improving the student experience \- from orientation through graduation. The CM leads the campus team and collaborates closely with other campus leads.
 



  





**Responsibilities**

title: Production Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 STAR KIDZ Footwear is part of Ojas Footwear India Pvt. Ltd., a leading manufacturer of kids’ footwear for ages 1 to 13, offering products for all children. The company manages well\-known brands including Star Kidz, Softride, and Scuba, recognized for quality, comfort, and innovative designs. Its success is driven by a strong mix of experienced professionals and emerging talent across design, development, production, quality control, sales, and customer service. STAR KIDZ Footwear provides a collaborative environment focused on continuous improvement and customer satisfaction, offering opportunities to contribute to a growing, dynamic business in the kids’ footwear segment.
   

  

**Role Description** 
 The Production Manager (PU machine) is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Bahadurgarh. This role oversees the end\-to\-end production process for kids’ footwear, ensuring that daily manufacturing targets are met while maintaining quality, safety, and cost efficiency. Responsibilities include planning and scheduling production runs, coordinating with design, procurement, and quality teams, and monitoring workflow on the shop floor. The Production Manager tracks material usage, manages inventory related to production, and addresses any operational bottlenecks or equipment issues to keep output on schedule. The role also involves leading and mentoring production staff, enforcing compliance with company standards and regulations, and implementing continuous improvement initiatives to optimize productivity and reduce waste.
   

  

  

**Qualifications**
* Demonstrated experience in production management or factory operations, preferably in footwear, apparel, or related manufacturing.
* Strong skills in production planning, scheduling, and resource allocation to meet daily and weekly output targets.
* Knowledge of quality control processes, safety standards, and compliance requirements in a manufacturing environment.
* Ability to manage and mentor shop\-floor teams, resolve operational issues, and foster a collaborative work culture.
* Comfort with using production reports, KPIs, and basic data analysis to drive decisions and process improvements.
* Effective communication and coordination skills for working with design, procurement, sales, and management teams.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Production Management, Industrial Engineering, Footwear Technology, or a related field is preferred.
* Experience with lean manufacturing, 5S, or other continuous improvement methodologies is an advantage.
* Ability to work on\-site in Bahadurgarh and adapt to a fast\-paced, growth\-oriented manufacturing setting.

title: Night Manager - Students Housing
description:
The Resident Night Manager will be responsible for the
 **overall management of student housing operations during the night shift** 
 , with primary accountability for
 **student safety, emergency response, and operational continuity** 
 .
 



  





 The position requires a strong
 **security and operations background** 
 and the ability to independently manage critical situations, lead night\-shift teams, coordinate with multiple support functions, and ensure strict adherence to Company / University policies and Student Housing SOPs.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Night Operations \& Student Safety** 



* Take overall responsibility for night\-time operations across assigned student residences.
* Conduct regular rounds of hostel buildings, common areas, entry/exit points and other critical areas.
* Ensure compliance with Student Housing policies, safety procedures and operational SOPs.
* Maintain a safe, secure and disciplined residential environment.



**2\. Incident \& Emergency Management** 



* Act as the senior on\-ground responder for significant night\-time incidents.
* Manage and coordinate response to:
* Medical emergencies
* Fire and life\-safety incidents
* Theft or suspected theft
* Security breaches
* Student conflicts and disturbances
* Unauthorized entry
* Property damage
* Missing/welfare\-related concerns
* Critical engineering or infrastructure failures
* Coordinate with Security, Wardens, Medical Centre, Engineering and University leadership.
* Ensure timely escalation, containment, documentation and follow\-up of incidents.



**4\. Student \& Conflict Management** 



* Maintain a professional, calm and approachable presence while dealing with students.
* Handle student concerns and conflicts with maturity and sensitivity.
* De\-escalate difficult situations and ensure student safety.
* Maintain confidentiality in sensitive student\-related matters.



**5\. Coordination with Technical Services** 



* Coordinate with the night Engineering / Technical Services team for critical issues relating to HVAC, electrical, plumbing, lifts, water supply, fire systems and other essential services.
* Ensure critical complaints are responded to within defined timelines.
* Escalate unresolved or high\-risk technical issues to the appropriate leadership.



**6\. Team Leadership** 



* Supervise and coordinate night\-shift Housekeeping and Technical Services personnel.
* Ensure manpower deployment as per approved roster.
* Monitor discipline, grooming, attendance and professional conduct.
* Conduct periodic surprise checks and operational audits.
* Ensure effective coordination among all night\-shift functions.



**7\. Reporting \& Handover** 



* Maintain a comprehensive Night Shift Operations \& Incident Log.
* Prepare daily night\-shift reports covering incidents, security observations, student concerns, emergencies and operational issues.
* Ensure complete handover of open and critical matters to the day team.
* Maintain accurate and confidential incident records.
